approved.en: Russia is intensifying airstrikes on Ukrainian energy sites, including power plants in Kyiv and civilian areas in Zaporizhzhia, while Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries and hit a Russian Iskander-M missile maintenance base. Ukraine also reported hitting six Russian Su-34 bomber jets with a Neptune missile and accused SpaceX of throttling Starlink terminals used for drone operations. Russian authorities detained a Japanese journalist on espionage charges and announced a diesel deal framed as an energy ceasefire, which Ukraine rejected as false. Elon Musk suggested the US government was behind any slowdown in Ukraine's Starlink and Starshield systems. The UCDP recorded 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Israel continues to block construction of a Gaza base created by the Trump peace board while air strikes killed a Palestinian woman in Gaza City and rescued a girl from a burning apartment. Iran saw two container ships sink near the Strait of Hormuz amid a surge in attacks, linking regional tension to the Gaza conflict. Gaza’s raw sewage is now flooding the Mediterranean as Israel restricts reconstruction, and art projects are linking Gaza and the West Bank, while a poll shows over half of Palestinians support a two-state solution and Hamas support is falling. The conflict caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iran så to containerskip synke nær Hormuzstredet i en bølge av angrep, og knyttet regional spenning til Gaza-konflikten. Gazas råavløp oversvømmer nå Middelhavet ettersom Israel begrenser gjenoppbygging, og kunstprosjekter knytter Gaza og Vestbredden sammen, mens en meningsmåling viser at over halvparten av palestinerne støtter en to-statsløsning og Hamas-støtten faller. Konflikten forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized in two Lebanese trucks have prompted Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation, while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel, a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack during a hike near the Lebanon border, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, leading the IDF chief to order a probe and authorities to consider restricting hikes. Students on the same hike fashioned tourniquets from belts and socks after the blast. Hezbollah announced compensation for Lebanese homeowners whose houses were destroyed and unveiled an aid plan for displaced civilians. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024.
approved.nb: Hezbollah-eksplosiver som ble beslaglagt i to libanesiske lastebiler har fått Libanons statsminister og sikkerhetsstyrker til å love en grundig etterforskning, mens israelsk artilleri og luftangrep fortsetter mot Hezbollah-posisjoner i sørlige Libanon, og forårsaker sivile tap. I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk under en fottur nær Libanongränsen, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som fikk IDF-sjefen til å beordre en undersøkelse og myndighetene til å vurdere restriksjoner på fotturer. Studenter på samme tur laget tourniquetter av belter og sokker etter eksplosjonen. Hezbollah kunngjorde erstatning til libanesiske huseiere hvis hus ble ødelagt og presenterte en hjelpsplan for fortrengte sivile. UCDP registrerte 4 335 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024.

Houthi forces have hit Saudi Aramco headquarters and a Saudi airport with missiles and drones, prompting Saudi air strikes on Houthi sites in Yemen. US officials are reportedly considering deploying the "mother of all bombs" against Iran if fighting resumes. 123 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Houthiene har truffet Saudi Aramcos hovedkvarter og en saudisk flyplass med missiler og droner, noe som har ført til saudiske luftangrep på houthi-steder i Jemen. Amerikanske tjenestemenn vurderer ifølge rapporter å bruke «the mother of all bombs» mot Iran dersom kampene gjenopptas. 123 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthis have intensified attacks on Saudi Arabia, striking Aramco headquarters, Riyadh airport and launching missiles toward Riyadh, while Saudi-led coalition forces have intercepted missiles and responded with airstrikes on oil facilities west of Sanaa and Houthi positions. The group is reportedly receiving more Chinese supplies to build ballistic missiles, expanding its strike capability. Fighting has overwhelmed hospitals and cut aid to 800,000 people, prompting warnings of a humanitarian catastrophe and cholera surges. Pilgrims have been caught up in Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia. The conflict produced 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Prime suspect in the 2013 Baniyas massacre was arrested and the alleged “Butcher of Baniyas" Ali Kayali was captured by Syrian security forces, while two men were sentenced to death for violent attacks and another pair received death sentences for coastal clashes. Turkish forces detained the chief suspect in the 2013 Turkey Reyhanlı attack who fled into Syria, and Turkish, Israeli and Kurdish actors continue to contest Syria's new order. Gunmen posing as security forces abducted a Kurdish woman law student in Damascus, and four road security personnel were killed in an eastern Hama attack. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Hovedmistenkt i Baniyas-massakren i 2013 ble arrestert, og den påståtte «Baniyas-slakteren» Ali Kayali ble pågrepet av syriske sikkerhetsstyrker, mens to menn ble dømt til døden for voldelige angrep og et annet par fikk dødsstraff for kystkonflikter. Tyrkiske styrker holdt fengslet hovedmistenkt i Reyhanlı-angrepet i Tyrkia i 2013, som flyktet til Syria, og tyrkiske, israelske og kurdiske aktører fortsetter å utfordre Syriens nye orden. Skytevåpenbevæpnede som utga seg for sikkerhetsstyrker bortførte en kurdisk kvinnelig jusstudent i Damaskus, og fire veisikkerhetsmedarbeidere ble drept i et angrep i Øst-Hama. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iraqi Prime Minister Barzani told Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman that Iraq will not allow its territory to be used for attacks on Saudi Arabia, and Iraq publicly pledged to prevent such attacks. At the same time, the pro-Iran militia Kataib Hezbollah warned it will target any hostile aircraft over Iraq, while a rival armed group said a weapons agreement with Iran remains stalled. Iraq’s Supreme Court declared the Kurdistan Region security law unconstitutional, and US firms are assessing air-defence investment in the Kurdistan Region. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Samtidig advarte den pro-iranske militsen Kataib Hezbollah at de vil treffe ethvert fiendtlig fly over Irak, mens en rivaliserende væpnet gruppe sa at en våpenavtale med Iran fortsatt er fastlåst. Iraks høyesterett erklærte Kordofan-regionens sikkerhetslov grunnlovsstridig, og amerikanske firmaer vurderer investering i luftvern i Kordofan-regionen. Konflikten registrerte 396 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The Sudanese Armed Forces launched air strikes on gold mining sites near the Sudan-Egypt border, killing dozens of miners, while the Rapid Support Forces used a paramilitary drone to strike near the Ethiopian frontier, adding civilian casualties in West Kordofan. In the Blue Nile, the Sudanese army repelled a joint RSF and SPLM-N attack, inflicting heavy losses on the attackers. Drought, war and climate-related drone attacks are worsening the humanitarian crisis and raising the risk of famine across Darfur, Kordofan and other regions. The conflict produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Den sudanske hæren (SAF) gjennomførte luftangrep på gullgruveområder nær grensen mot Egypt, og drepte dusinvis av gruvearbeidere, mens RSF-militsen brukte en paramilitær drone til å angripe nær grensen mot Etiopia, og påførte flere sivile tap i West Kordofan. I Blue Nile avviste hæren et felles angrep fra RSF og SPLM-N, og påførte angriperne store tap. Tørke, krig og klima-relaterte droneangrep forverrer den humanitære krisen og øker risikoen for hungersnød i Darfur, Kordofan og andre regioner. Konflikten førte til 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Communal clashes in Lakes state, especially around Rumbek, have intensified with curfews imposed and caretaker governor Rin Tueny returning to address the violence. UNMISS has increased civilian protection efforts after deadly attacks in Rumbek, while SSPDF soldiers were wounded in an assault on a Mundri West military outpost and the U.S. Embassy condemned an assault on WFP workers in Jonglei that involved looting of aid. An AIC cleric was shot dead in Juba and a Juba High Court sentenced five officers to 24 years for raiding a general's home. The lethal communal violence now far exceeds the two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian forces have seized a key town in Tigray, taken its regional airport and are moving toward an Eritrean border town, while fighting in Amhara has left at least 183 dead, according to the UN. The United States has stepped up diplomatic pressure and called for de-escalation as the conflict spreads. Leaders of Egypt, Eritrea, Sudan and Somalia are meeting to coordinate security operations if the fighting crosses borders. The war has caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA har økt diplomatisk press og oppfordret til de-eskalering ettersom konflikten sprer seg. Ledere fra Egypt, Eritrea, Sudan og Somalia møtes for å koordinere sikkerhetsoperasjoner dersom kampene krysser grenser. Krigen har forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Fitgharin forces have tightened their grip on the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces claim capture of Buurhakaba after heavy fighting in the Bay region, and fighters loyal to a former regional president have also seized Burhakaba. Somalia is screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case and is hosting regional talks in Egypt with Eritrea, Sudan and its own officials to coordinate security amid rising Ethiopia-Eritrea tensions. The federal government is deepening defence ties with Pakistan, seeking JF‑17 fighter jets and securing the release of four Pakistani sailors freed from Somali pirates. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Somalia screener reisende etter at Kenya bekreftet et importert ebolatilfelle, og landet er vert for regionale samtaler i Egypt med Eritrea, Sudan og egne tjenestemenn for å koordinere sikkerheten i lys av økende spenninger mellom Etiopia og Eritrea. Den føderale regjeringen utdyper forsvarssamarbeidet med Pakistan, søker JF‑17‑jagerfly og sikrer løslatelsen av fire pakistanske sjømenn som ble frigjort fra somaliske pirater. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
